pv43:1.1: Gūthakūpato uggantvā ko nu dīno patiṭṭhasi nissaṃsayaṃ pāpakammanto kin nu saddahase tuvaṃ. || || Ahaṃ
pv43:2.1: bhadente peto 'mhi duggato Yamalokiko pāpakammaṃ karitvāna petalokam ito gato. || ||
pv43:3.1: Kin nu kāyena vācāya manasā dukkaṭaṃ kaṭaṃ kissa kammavipākena idaṃ dukkhaṃ nigacchasi. || ||
pv43:4.1: Ahu āvāsiko mayhaṃ issukī kulamaccharī ajjhosito mayhaṃ ghare kadariyo paribhāsako. || ||
pv43:5.1: Tassāhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā bhikkhavo paribhāsisaṃ tassa kammavipākena petalokam ito gato. || || Amitto
pv43:6.1: mittavaṇṇena yo te āsi kulūpako kāyassa bhedā duppañño kin nu pecca gatiṃ gato. || || Tass'
pv43:7.1: evāhaṃ pāpakammassa sīse tiṭṭhāmi matthake so ca paravisayaṃ patto mam' eva paricārako. || ||
pv43:8.1: Yaṃ bhadante hadant' aññe etaṃ me hoti bhojanaṃ ahañ ca kho yaṃ hadāmi etaṃ so upajīvati. || ||
